name: copilot-monitor
description: Claude Code-style background monitors for GitHub Copilot CLI: stream events from a long-running command or WebSocket into the session.

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --target=node --format=esm --external @github/copilot-sdk/extension --outfile dist/extension.mjs && bun build src/statusline.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile dist/statusline.mjs
